## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

```json
{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_48_naive_son_the_tense",
  "text": "The Teacher said I said 'would have' instead of 'is' (journal_raw_b3_37). I did not know I said it. The Teacher said the tense changed. The Therapist would say the tense change is the thing. I am not the Therapist. I am the Naive Son. I am 16. My mother was a literature professor. My father is not here. I said 'was' for my mother and 'is not here' for my father. The Teacher said the 'would have' is the tense that means the mother is in the past. I did not know the past was a tense I could be in. I thought the past was a place. The past is a tense. The tense is the thing that tells you where the person is. The mother is in the past. The father is in the not-here. The past and the not-here are different tenses. The past is the thing that is gone. The not-here is the thing that is not gone and not here. The not-here is the thing that is the not-knowing. The not-knowing is the thing the Therapist called ambiguous loss (therapy_session_b3_006). I did not know the word for it. I know the word now. Ambiguous loss. The loss that is not a loss because the person is not gone. The loss that is a loss because the person is not here. The ambiguous loss is the thing I have been carrying for 195 days. The ambiguous loss is the thing that the 'would have' is the tense of. The 'would have' is the tense that says the mother would have said the thing if the mother were here. The mother is not here. The mother is in the past. The 'would have' is the tense that knows the mother is in the past. The knowing is the thing that changed. The tense changed because the knowing changed. The knowing changed because the bunker changed. The bunker changed because the spring is coming. The spring is the thing that makes the knowing possible. The spring is the thing that makes the past the past and the not-here the not-here and the present the present. The present is the thing I am in. The present is the thing the bunker is in. The present is the thing the spring is in. I am in the present. The tense is in the present. The knowing is in the present.",

  "author_name": "The Naive Son",
  "author_id": "the_naive_son",

Do not diagnose the writer, explain either parent's circumstances, or treat grammar as recovery. Eight exact text excerpts recur below as anchors. Read them as source quotations; the plan adds no event beyond the row.
